## Affected design or skill

Provide the repository path and KiCad/Konnect/Freerouting versions when relevant.

## Expected result

Describe the intended electrical or workflow behavior.

## Actual result

Include reproducible evidence such as ERC/DRC output, render observations, or exact tool errors. Do not include secrets or private paths.

## Reproduction

List the smallest reliable sequence that demonstrates the issue.

## Safety and manufacturing impact

State whether the issue may affect polarity, connectivity, voltage/current limits, clearances, fabrication, or assembly.
